title: Not sure what makes it cool...
text: Not sure what makes it cool.... I know the gel is supposed to make it cool.  This blanket is soft and holds my sheet down over me so that I don't need a heavier blanket, so I guess in that way it is cooler.  It could be a little larger.

product_metadata.title: KPBLIS Cooling Bamboo Blankets for Hot Sleepers, Lightweight Summer Big Cool Blankets Queen Size, Thin Bamboo Extra Cool Throw Blankets for Hot Flashes (79x91 inches, Light Grey)
features: Bamboo Fabric: Natural bamboo microfiber is silky softness, feels quite comfortable and cool to the touch right off the bat. The unique diamond pattern design can enhance air circulation through the lightweight blanket, cool air to help you enjoy a really relaxing sleep.

Thin Blanket for Summer: Our cold touch bamboo fiber has a high specific heat capacity, it instantly feels cool on your skin when you touch this summer blanket. Cooling blankets for hot sleepers keep cool. You can use this lightweight blanket all night without getting the sweats, dry all night.

Color and size: We provide a variety of sizes and colors to choose from. 79x91 inches summer blanket queen size is suitable for kids, teen, adult that who wants a comfortable blanket to keep cool! Bamboo blankets will shrink a little, we recommend that you choose a bigger one to use.

Easy to Clean: This cool blanket is suitable for machine wash in cold water or hand wash. Please don't put it in the dryer! Please hang it on the clothes hanger vertically and dry in a cool ventilated place, then the thin blanket will restore to its original size. In order to extend the life of the blanket, we do not recommend that you use it as a bed sheet to cover your bed! It is best to use as covering your body to keep you comfortable!

Satisfactory Service: Cooling blanket is a perfect gift for anyone you love. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, please contact us. We will give you a satisfied answer, providing satisfactory service is our aim.
